title: Admin overview
loginDescription: Sign in with an authorized administrator account to manage ARTIFACTS.
noProducts: No products have been added yet.
catalogManagementDescription: Products, variants, collections, and media will be available here as each admin section is enabled.
chatDescription: Review customer conversations and reply from one place.
chatSelect: Select a conversation to view its history.
tryonDescription: Preview a garment on a model with FASHN AI. Choose a person photo and a product photo to start a prediction.
tryonModelDescription: Choose a clear, full-body photo of the person who will wear the product.
tryonProductDescription: Choose a clear image of the garment or fashion item to try on.
tryonImageTypes: JPG, PNG, or WEBP · up to 8 MB
tryonFailed: The try-on prediction failed. Check the images and try again.
tryonMissingOutput: The prediction completed without returning an image.
tryonUnknownStatus: The provider returned an unrecognized status.
tryonStatusError: Unable to retrieve the prediction status. Try again.
tryonRequestError: Unable to start the try-on request. Check your connection and try again.
tryonImageTooLarge: Each image must be 8 MB or smaller.
tryonHistoryDescription: Your predictions are saved here. Refresh an item to retrieve its latest status and result. FASHN result links may expire after three days.
tryonExpiredImage: This result image is no longer available from FASHN.
